title: Inspect flickery orbit render frames
objective: Inspect the generated orbit collection frames/videos directly and diagnose why scene_off_flashlight_on is still flickery / looks scene-on
instructions: User reports the latest orbit render is still super flickery and looks like scene-on. Inspect generated outputs directly, especially examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation/{scene_on_flashlight_off,scene_off_flashlight_on,scene_on_flashlight_on}. Review RGB PNG frames, depth viridis PNGs, raw metadata.json, and videos if useful. Quantify brightness/flicker across consecutive frames and compare the three lighting conditions. Determine whether the failure appears to be scene lights leaking, auto exposure/tonemapping, temporal/GI accumulation, camera/pose changes, video encoding, stale outputs, or capture/readback instability. Do not edit product code. Return concrete findings with frame paths, metadata evidence, stats, and recommended next Builder action.
expected_outputs: Inspector ResultPacket with visual/statistical diagnosis, representative frame paths or generated inspection artifacts if any, and recommended fix direction.
definition_of_done: The actual rendered frame outputs have been inspected and the most likely source of flicker / scene-on appearance is identified, or blockers are clearly stated.
